notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla parses SMSG_MONSTER_MOVE: packed mover guid, start, spline id, moveType-switched facing, then the flag-keyed spline block (linear endpoint+packed offsets vs Catmull-Rom absolute points), with a stop short-circuit and a special count==2 no-offsets rule. MSUI's MonsterMoveParser ports the head, stop short-circuit, both spline layouts and the flying flag, but diverges on two points.
